predecessors.name: kiliman
predecessors.text: Buayan's core round Sarangani Bay (South Cotabato and General Santos), the stand-in the Maguindanao dossier uses; the page gives no boundary and says only that Buayan 'had a port in Sarangani Bay'…

successors.name: United States of America
successors.text: Buayan's core round Sarangani Bay (South Cotabato and General Santos), the stand-in the Maguindanao dossier uses; the page gives no boundary and says only that Buayan 'had a port in Sarangani Bay'…

ledger.x: 1671: Kudarat's reign ends and Buayan's subjection lapses.
22 October 1905: the sultanate ends at the Battle of the Malala River (infobox: successors the Insular Government of the Philippines and the Moro Province).

wars.name: Rajah Silongan against Maguindanao and Spain
wars.outcome: 'In April 1596, Rajah Silongan held off against the joint forces of Maguindanao and Spain.'

wars.name: Battle of the Malala River (American conquest)
wars.outcome: Datu Ali is killed at the Malala River on 22 October 1905 and Buayan is absorbed into the American colonial administration.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier or area; the Sarangani Bay stand-in is a core, not the extent of the interior alliances.
